# HEM v0.6.1b17 — Unified per-device settings and translated prompts

- **Compact per-device card.** Keep only the physical device heading, controller method selection (including individual mode methods), state/diagnostics, Continue Automatic and the small ON/OFF policy tiles. Remove the duplicate manual targets, PID calibration inputs, PID capacity editors and other configuration panels from the card.
- **One categorized HEM device settings menu.** The controller settings gear now opens the full device-owned configuration entities grouped by purpose, **without repeating the entire card above the categories**. Existing Home/room settings groups and exact-device ownership remain intact. PID tuning for an operating mode stays under PID rather than being misclassified under Modes.
- **Clearer window-opening preference.** Rename the device-level prompt to “Prompt to open windows to avoid using this device” / “Προτροπή ανοίγματος παραθύρων για αποφυγή χρήσης αυτής της συσκευής”, with purpose-equivalent translations across 38 supported languages. Its original scope, timers and announcement logic do not change.
- **Localization audit.** Display translated dropdown option labels from the entity's exact options metadata or Home Assistant's translated select states, while leaving service-call option IDs unchanged. Provide translated full-menu category headings for all 38 supported HEM locales and add a regression audit of the locale catalogs.
- **Safety unchanged.** Native command permission, physical device ownership, windows, PID math, quiet rules, minimum ON/OFF timing and restart reconciliation are not changed by this UI/translation release.

Install through HACS/Marketplace, restart Home Assistant, and refresh the Lovelace card. Verify a multifunction climate controller, an air purifier and the full-device settings dialog; all on/off switches must retain their original values and exact targets.
